note: The 11-query bake-off battery. Written once, read by BOTH sides, so the two harnesses provably run identical strings. Separate from bakeoff-queries.json, which is jointly owned and asserted against by atlas-side.js — do not fold these in.

queries.q: films like The Banshees of Inisherin
queries.probes: THE DISCRIMINATING TEST, exemplar form. Fingerprint distance put Ex Machina 2.8 from Banshees and buried Old Joy at #1291/2197. Where does each land here?

queries.q: a friendship that ends without either man saying so
queries.probes: THE DISCRIMINATING TEST, plain-language form. No title token to grab, no genre noun. Pure story shape + felt quality.

queries.q: a film that has fast pacing, has the mood of the matrix, has a hopeful tone, has little dialogue, very spiritual in nature
queries.probes: The owner's own sentence. Nearly all of it is INSIDE the 59-attribute vocabulary (pace, tone:hopeful, texture:sparse-dialogue, subject:spiritual) plus one film named as an exemplar. Home ground for the incumbent.

queries.q: a cold austere film that keeps you at arm's length
queries.probes: PURE MOOD. Names no event, no object, no genre — only a felt quality. If dense retrieval degenerates to title matching anywhere, it is here.
A FILM NAMED AS AN EXEMPLAR, with a title that is also a common noun. The incumbent resolves the film to its attributes; the dense side embeds the string. Tests title leakage at its sharpest.

queries.q: a con artist who is never quite caught
queries.probes: A STORY SHAPE WITH NO DISTINCTIVE VOCABULARY. 'con artist' is outside the 59 attributes; it is also not a word that appears in most plot summaries of con films. Neither side has an easy handle.

queries.q: a film built around a game of chess
queries.probes: SOMETHING RARE, with a knowable right answer. Only 8 of 2,204 plots mention chess; the films a person means are The Seventh Seal and The Chess Players. 'chess' is outside the closed vocabulary entirely, so this is dense retrieval's best possible case.

queries.q: kitchen sink realism about dockworkers and a wildcat strike
queries.probes: MOST WORDS OUTSIDE ANY VOCABULARY. The incumbent can read at most subject:work / subject:class; the rest is unread. Dense retrieval has real plot nouns to anchor on.
SELF-CONTRADICTORY, and contradictory INSIDE the vocabulary (pace:relentless vs pace:contemplative). Does either side notice, or does each quietly average the two?

queries.q: a paranoid film about surveillance and control
queries.probes: shared sanity query 1 — core nouns outside the vocabulary. Reference point: The Conversation.

queries.q: a revenge film that isn't violent
